label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled host parameter flows directly to both DNS resolution (resolveHost/host) and subsequent outbound HTTP connection (connectHttpByHostname). The isNonPublicAddress check only blocks known local addresses but permits arbitrary public IPs/domains. Attacker can supply malicious hostnames that resolve to internal networks. Resolved sink value at line 46 is the user-supplied host parameter.

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, then to resolveHost() and connectHttpByHostname()
